name: Meshfree Isosurface Computation for BEM
definition: A method to compute isosurfaces for scalar fields (e.g., electric potential u(r)) from Boundary Element Method (BEM) data without an auxiliary post-processing volume mesh. It combines an adaptive octree scheme for isovalue search with FMM-accelerated BEM to compute field values directly via series expansions, avoiding dense volume meshes.
summary: Meshfree Isosurface Computation for BEM generates isosurfaces from boundary element data without auxiliary volume meshes, using octree-based searches and Taylor series expansions for high accuracy and adjustable resolution.
